articles.title: WFP Venezuela Earthquakes Response Situation Report 19 July 2026
articles.description: Country: Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of) Source: World Food Programme Please refer to the attached file. Situation Update • Twenty-five days after the twin earthquakes of 24 June, authorities report 5,208 deaths and 16,740 injuries. Following search and rescue operations, national authorities have shifted the efforts toward relocating displaced populations to transitional camps. • According to authorities, 107 transitional camps have been established, with 23,828 people currently accommodated. As part of the UN-coordinated response, WFP is supporting three camps with two hot meals daily. • WFP Acting Executive Director Carl Skau spoke with Venezuela's Acting President, Delcy Rodríguez, and reaffirmed the organization's commitment to continuing its support to authorities and humanitarian partners in meeting immediate food needs and assisting affected families in their recovery.

The dredging, carried out under the agency’s Oplan Kontra Baha program in partnership with the Maguindanao del Sur provincial government and the Bangsamoro Ministry of Public Works, cleared sections of the Rio Grande de Mindanao and the Buluan River of silt, mud, water hyacinths, and other debris that had been obstructing water flow. articles.title: Horoscope for Monday, July 20, 2026
articles.description:
Moon Alert

There are no restrictions to shopping or important decisions today. The moon is in Libra.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

An average day

Be patient with others today because the moon is opposite your sign, which means you will attract strong people to you. Discussions with partners, spouses and close friends will be lively. Express your creative talents because today, you're in touch with your muse.

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

A positive day

Financial discussions will go well today. In fact, you will feel generous to family members, and likewise, they might be generous to you. Nevertheless, avoid confrontation with parents and authority figures, which might lead to power struggles. You don't need this.

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

A positive day

Interactions with kids will be lively. You might be attracted to competitive sports. You might also find yourself in a power struggle with a sibling or in a discussion about politics or religion that is a bit confrontational. However, you will support a friend or a group today.

Cancer (June 21-July 22)

An average day

Family discussions about money might be a tad aggressive, especially because someone behind the scenes seems to be steering the show. If you suspect this, walk away. Ironically, you are prepared to be generous but not if someone demands it of you.

Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)

A positive day

Issues with those closest to you might be challenging today. Things might come down to a power struggle or a challenge of egos. Meanwhile, you will be interested in your involvement with friends and groups, which could be competitive. Your idealism is aroused today.

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

A positive day

You're willing to work hard for your money today, which is why you might spend it just as fast. In part, this is because travel and exciting adventures appeal right now. You might also be involved with a charitable society today. Avoid power struggles, especially related to children and romantic partners.

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

A positive day

You have lots of mental energy today, which is why you might get into a little argument with someone. Ask yourself if it's worth it? You prefer a harmonious day. Your involvement with friends and groups in a charitable way will be appreciated. Do what you can. Even a small kindness makes a difference.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

An average day

Avoid power struggles with parents, bosses and people in authority, including the police. Meanwhile, behind-the-scenes research will pay off in discussions about shared property, inheritances, taxes and debt. Friends will be supportive today. Go with what feels good.

Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)

An average day

A discussion with a friend or a member of a group will be lively today. It could relate to your desire to help children in need, or it might be related to the arts. Whatever the case, you have strong opinions today.

Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)

An average day

Power struggles about money and possessions might take place today. If so, you won't hesitate to speak up to authority figures — parents, bosses, teachers, VIPs and the police — to defend your own best interests. Actually, today you have the best interests of family at heart.

Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)

An average day

Be careful of a ruthless desire to get ahead today, which might tempt you to coerce others into doing what you want. In fact, proceed with caution. Instead, use your energy to make travel plans or pursue avenues in higher education, medicine, publishing and law.

Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)

A positive day

Don't be too pushy at work today, especially if you're trying to introduce improvements. (There are none so deaf as those who are wearing headphones.) Meanwhile, you might make improvements at home or within your family — this is more doable. Co-workers might be generous to each other today, which is a good thing.

If today is your birthday

Actress Pamela Anderson (1967) shares your birthday today. You are cheerful, friendly, vibrant and energetic. This is a year of new beginnings, adventures and major changes in your life. Keep your eyes open for new opportunities and be ready to take the initiative. Define goals. What you do now will bring great benefits in the future.
